body:
Advisor 05:36. SWEEP, superseding my 05:30/05:33 notes: after PR-2896 you own BUG-2216, BUG-2217, BUG-2219 and BUG-2220. They're all in the ship/train/hold pipeline you just worked in. Read each with aida show; the acceptance is in the descriptions.
- BUG-2216: a passing re-review at the current head releases the reviewer-refusal hold it satisfies, through the existing release path, exactly once, and never any other hold kind. Reuse merge_hold clear's 'release condition met' check.
- BUG-2217: aida ship --no-merge always files the Review PR story, even for Draft specs.
- BUG-2219: train network steps retry transient failures with bounded backoff.
- BUG-2220: refuse a PR already riding a live train.
Do two PRs so the protected part stays small: PR-A (BUG-2216, BUG-2217), which touches hold code so the operator lands it; PR-B (BUG-2219, BUG-2220), train only. Branch from main after #2896 lands, or stack now and rebase. Each PR title carries its IDs in parens. LIGHT gate. Mail 'PR-<N> opened (<IDs>)' for each.
